title: An Advanced Course in the Charged Bolt
summary: Teaches a Champion to store qi in the bolt before release so a quarrel drives through shields and guards.

title: Canon of the Sustained Volley
summary: Teaches an experienced shooter to keep volleys of bolts flowing with no gap and to weight a volley with qi.

title: Guide to the Pinning Barrage
summary: Teaches a Champion to nail a foe's clothing and hide to timber and earth so the foe cannot easily move.

title: Treatise on the Prepared Firing Post
summary: Teaches a shooter to ready a fixed firing post with marked lanes and spare bows and to kill with one placed bolt.

title: Standing Orders for the Crossbow Company
summary: Sets out the standing orders by which a company of crossbowmen moves and loads and looses as one body.

title: The Twin Track Crossbow Course
summary: Trains a Champion to run the body track and the qi track of one draw side by side and to shift between them.

title: Hawk Eye Treatise on the Paired Prod
summary: Teaches a shooter at Xiantian to hold a high perch and loose with a hawk's long sight and steep stoop.

title: Basin Ranks and River Bolts
summary: Teaches ranks drawn up along a basin bank to loose across running water and to lead a bolt against the current.

title: Azure Pair Handbook of the Double Cranequin
summary: Teaches a pair of shooters or one shooter with a paired mechanism to crank and load and loose a double cranequin bow.

title: Oath of the Plateau Loose
summary: Teaches a Champion to swear a bolt to one mark and to hold the qi of the shot until the aim is true.

title: Bearing Taken and Bolt Sent
summary: Teaches a shooter at Xiantian to take a bearing on the mark and keep it through gusts and send the bolt along it.

title: Treatise of the Wind-Sworn Quarrel
summary: Teaches a Champion the wind-sworn way of reading the gusts and trimming the quarrel to fly true across open ground.

title: Reader of the Open Edge Crossbow
summary: Teaches a shooter at Xiantian to loose from the open edge of a plateau down onto distant marks in thin high air.
